title: Definite integral
task: Numerically calculate a definite integral of a given function over a stated interval.

steps.text: Type int in a new expression line to open the integral template.
Enter the lower bound, then the upper bound, then the integrand, then the differential.
Tab exits the current field once it is filled.
With f defined, the integrand can be f(x) itself.

exam_habit.text: A value obtained from a graphing calculator without the equation, function or definite integral that was entered loses the setup point, so the setup is written beside the result.
A decimal approximation reported to fewer than three places after the decimal point loses the answer point.

sources.anchor_quote: Type int (or integral if working in the Geometry Tool) in an expression line.
enter a lower bound, upper bound, integrand, and differential
numerically calculate the value of a definite integral
students are required to write the setup (e.g., the equation being solved, or the derivative or definite integral being evaluated)
